name: Smooth Rod 10 mm
summary: 10 mm hardened linear shaft, 300 mm long
description: A straight 10 mm guide rod, 300 mm long, with lightly chamfered ends.
source: 10 mm is the standard nominal outside diameter for LM10UU linear bearing shafting and is confirmed by the bore sizes of the LM10UU and LM10LUU bearings listed on their datasheets; the 300 mm length is a common retail cut length and is set as a modelling default rather than a fixed product dimension.
